_comment: Railpack build config. Read by BOTH Railway services that point at this
directory — the API and the nightly backup cron — so it must contain only
things that are correct for both.
That is why there is no startCommand here. The backup service needs
`npm run backup` and the API needs its server; a start command in this
shared file would eventually be picked up by whichever service Railway
migrated to Railpack next, and an API silently running the backup script
instead of listening is a total outage. Start commands stay per-service in
the Railway UI.
postgresql-client-17 puts pg_dump in the image, which the base Node image
does not have — without it the backup fails with `spawn pg_dump ENOENT`.
The API does not use it and pays only a few MB for it, which is cheaper
than a second build config to keep in step.
Pinned to 17 because the client must be the same major version as the
server or newer. Supabase is on 17.6 and moves without asking; when it
goes to 18, pg_dump fails with an explicit version-mismatch message and
the fix is to raise this number. Debian trixie carries 17 as its default.
Replaces nixpacks.toml, which Railway's Railpack builder does not read.
That file stays until the API service is confirmed off the deprecated
Nixpacks builder, then it can go.
